decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The linked PR [ev-5690c45af524] says the change "disables IMDS access from pods by reducing hop limit to 1". That states the subject (the IMDS hop limit), the change (reduced to 1) and the consequence (pods lose access to IMDS). The changed files [ev-7e557f5b719f][ev-3e147ec5d8b9] are the EC2NodeClass CRD and ec2nodeclass.go, so the change is to the EC2NodeClass hop-limit default, which affects node classes that do not set the hop limit themselves. Confidence is low because the exact field path and the previous value are not written out and have to be inferred from the changed files.
